# Mindgard raises £22m Series A as AI security funding matures
London and Boston-based **Mindgard Mindgard** has raised $30m (£22m) in Series A funding led by Album VC, with participation from existing backers including .406 Ventures and IQ Capital.
The round is a substantial step up from previous raises (see - Mindgard raises further $8m for AI security testing ), and comes roughly two years after the company was spun out of Lancaster University with £3m in seed funding (see - Mindgard raises £3m for securing AI models ).
